payload._note: Healthcare Services Group, Inc. (HCSG) is a management services company that provides housekeeping, laundry, dietary, and facility maintenance services to approximately 2,700 healthcare facilities (approximately 2,300 for Housekeeping services and approximately 1,700 for Dietary services) as of December 31, 2023. The 10-K does not contain a detailed facility roster with individual facility names, locations, or Medicare CCNs. HCSG operates as a B2B service provider to healthcare facility operators rather than directly operating facilities themselves. The filing notes that Genesis Healthcare contributed 10.9% of consolidated revenues in 2023, but no comprehensive list of client facilities or their CCNs is disclosed. The company provides services throughout the continental United States but does not break down facilities by specific location in this filing. Item 2 (Properties) confirms they lease corporate and regional offices but does not list customer facilities. No supplemental schedules with facility-level detail were found in the excerpts provided.
